confirmed.title: High-Order Triadic Functional Connectivity in the Brain and Beyond
confirmed.abstract: Introduces a matrix-based entropy-functional method for estimating triadic (three-way) statistical dependencies among brain regions, applied to large-scale functional brain networks; resulting triadic networks reveal community structure complementary to pairwise functional connectivity.

confirmed.title: Modulation Analysis with Higher-Order Spectra
confirmed.abstract: Explores spectral decompositions of higher-order cumulants (higher-order spectra) as an alternative to filtering/envelope-extraction for identifying modulation of spectral power in physiological signals, emphasizing the trispectrum viewed as the cross spectrum of the Wigner-Ville distribution.

confirmed.title: Slow breathing impacts inter-organ dynamics modulating brain function and risk behavior
confirmed.abstract: Instructed prolonged exhalation (a slow-breathing technique) increased risky choices, enhanced reward sensitivity, and elevated cardiac parasympathetic activity; greater parasympathetic upregulation tracked stronger reward-related fMRI responses in ventromedial prefrontal cortex and precuneus.
